overview: QuickShop is a full-featured e-commerce web app with product browsing by category, cart and wishlist management, Stripe checkout, order tracking, a review and rating system, discount coupons, and a protected admin panel for managing products, orders, and coupons.
features: Product catalog with category filtering (Clothing, Electronics, Food) and search
Product detail pages with images, price, description, and reviews
Shopping cart and wishlist with persistent state
Discount coupon codes with percentage or fixed-amount discounts
Stripe-powered secure checkout with order confirmation
Order history and status tracking (Pending, Processing, Shipped, Delivered)
Review and rating system with star ratings and comments
Admin panel for managing products, orders, and coupons
User authentication with role-based access (customer and admin roles)
Email notifications on order creation and status updates
